shared_elements: low-relief carved creature seen in profile
curvilinear outline figures filling the stone surface
repeated figures arranged one above another
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic creatures rendered as raised, smooth-bodied silhouettes in profile with hooked heads and little interior detail, and in both the figures crowd the available surface in loosely stacked groupings. But the specific content differs: A is dominated by tight concentric spirals and crouching anthropomorphic beaked figures with large round eyes, while B shows a striding long-tailed quadruped beneath a band of slender elongated animals, with no spirals or human-like bodies.
